We had the most wonderful experience with Emma and her team. From the very start, they went above and beyond to help us, fitting us in despite a full calendar, which meant so much given our situation.

We had just rescued our Persian girl, Pumpkin, who was extremely matted, uncomfortable, and understandably very nervous and distrustful of humans. She was in real distress due to the pelting, and we were quite worried about how she would cope.

Emma and her team were absolute angels with her - so gentle, patient, and deeply compassionate. They gave Pumpkin a much-needed lion trim, completely transforming her comfort and wellbeing. You could truly feel their love and understanding of cats in every step of the process.

It’s rare to come across such genuine care and dedication. We are beyond grateful and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone - especially if your cat needs a little extra kindness and expertise.

Thank you again for taking such beautiful care of Pumpkin 🎃 🐈‍⬛ 🦁 💓

I took my show cocker to this groomer expecting a routine groom, but they completely shaved off his beautiful coat, including his lovely ears without asking for my consent.

When I dropped Bailey off, I showed the groomer a photo of his usual grooming. She took a photo and we discussed keeping his coat a bit longer this time as it is still cold outside. There was some matting on his belly and chest which of course needed to be removed, but there was no discussion at all about shaving his ears. For context, his ears have always been brushed and gently trimmed with scissors, so that is what I expected this time as well.

I’m extremely disappointed by the lack of communication. To make matters worse, I was also charged more than the quoted price for this experience. If I had known this was what they intended to do, I would have taken him to his usual groomer despite the longer drive.

When I raised the issue with the owner (who was not the person I spoke to when dropping Bailey off), she insisted that a completely different conversation had taken place and claimed that I had agreed to have his ears shaved, which I would never do. She did agree to issue a refund due to the misunderstanding, but I have yet to receive it.

Owners of show or long-coated breeds should be cautious.

The first photo shows the result from this visit, which I have never seen on a show cocker. The second photo shows Bailey’s usual groom, and the last photo shows Bailey a week before the appointment, where you can see there was no significant matting on his ears as the business claims.

Wonderful Groomer – Highly Recommend for Anxious Dogs!

We brought our dog Rusty in after struggling for years to find a groomer who could manage his anxiety. You never expect grooming to become such a huge challenge when you first get a dog — but when you end up with one who is terrified of the process, it becomes incredibly difficult. We spent over a year trying everything under the sun, and at one point Rusty even needed to be put under anaesthetic for grooming because it had become so stressful for him.

But Edina did what no one else has been able to do. She managed to give him a full groom — something we never thought would happen again. Rusty looked brilliant afterwards, despite asking her to cut his fur to a very short length, and most importantly, he’s much more comfortable than he was. She went above and beyond, even sent us videos of when she was working with him, and we received a lovely report afterwards complete with a before-and-after photo.

We’re so impressed, incredibly happy, grateful, and will definitely be going back. I cannot recommended this groomer enough, especially if you have an anxious and reactive dog when it comes to grooming. Thank you so much Edina!

Not every groomer would be able to handle him so well and I am very grateful we have found Edina. I would definitely recommend Clique Grooming. Excellent service.

We’ve tried two other groomers before, and to be honest, they were very underwhelming. I even ended up clipping our dog myself a few times, which wasn’t great. Then I came across Clique Pet Grooming after hearing good things, and I’m so glad I gave them a try.

The difference was incredible. I have never seen our dog, Cookie,  look this good. He’s a little nervous by nature, but the team were so kind and reassuring that I knew he was in safe hands. At one point they even called in an extra pair of hands to help, and they managed it with total calm and professionalism. Nothing seemed to faze them.

What stood out most was the care and attention they gave throughout. This wasn’t just a haircut, it was a proper grooming experience, and our dog came out looking the best he ever has.

If you’re looking for groomers who are not only brilliant at what they do but also genuinely care for the dogs they work with, I cannot recommend Clique Pet Grooming highly enough. They’ve set the bar, and I wouldn’t take our dog anywhere else now.
